title: Makefile targets reference an undefined variable, a misspelled tool and a BSD-only flag
body:
Three problems in the root `Makefile`.

- Target `r1` runs `$(SEARCH) C 1.sufr` (line 19). No `SEARCH` variable is defined, so the command line is empty before `C`.
- Target `valcall` runs `valgrind --tool=callrind` (line 89). The tool is `callgrind`.
- `CREATE_RELEASE` uses `/usr/bin/time -l` (line 12). `-l` is the BSD form and GNU `time` rejects it.

Several benchmark targets also read machine-local paths such as `../data/chr1.fa`, `hs1.fa`, `elegans.fa` and `ecoli.fa`, which are not in the repository.

Seen by reading the Makefile in the survey. No target was run.
